disclaimer: Written with AI from public news reports and social media. Scores are editorial judgments, not measured social media volume. Social links open keyword searches, not individual posts.
method: Buzz (how much it will be talked about), impact (how far it reaches), timeliness (is it new today) and staying power (will it last for days) are each rated out of 10 and averaged.
Issues averaging under 5.0 are dropped, so some fields have fewer than 10. Dropped items are listed at the bottom of each tab.
Items marked “Gen Z trend” are picked from trend media and youth surveys covering what spreads on Reels, Threads and TikTok.
Scores are Claude's judgment based on news reports, not counts of posts.

about.title: About World Issues Today
about.desc: What this site shows, how issues are picked and scored, and its limits.
sections: World Issues Today collects the issues people in Korea, the United States, Japan, China and Europe are talking about on social media, sorts them into tech & economy, politics, culture & society and incidents, and explains each in English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese. It also explains the day's top 10 GitHub Trending repositories.

Every day at 6:00 AM Korea time, an AI (Claude, made by Anthropic) searches public news reports and trend media, picks issues from the last 24 hours and writes the summaries and explanations. Every issue links to the news report it is based on.

Buzz, impact, timeliness and staying power are each rated out of 10 and averaged. Issues under 5.0 are left out. Scores are editorial judgments based on the cited reports, not counts of posts or views.
Social media platforms do not let us read posts directly, so the site relies on news coverage. Summaries can contain mistakes. Check the linked source before relying on an item.
If you spot an error, email {email}. Confirmed mistakes are fixed in the next update.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: What information World Issues Today collects and how ads and cookies work.
sections: There are no accounts, comments or sign-up forms. We do not ask for or store your name or payment details. If you email us, we use your address only to reply.
The site remembers the tab and language you chose using your browser's local storage. This stays on your device and is never sent to us.

This site may show ads from Google and its partners. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies lets it and its partners serve ads based on those visits. You can turn off personalized ads at {ads_settings}. To learn how Google uses information from sites that use its services, see {partners}. Once ads are enabled, visitors in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland will be asked for consent before personalized ads are shown.
Donations go through Ko-fi ({kofi}). Payments are handled by Ko-fi and its payment providers under their own privacy policies. This site never receives your card details.

The site is served by Cloudflare, which may keep standard access logs, such as IP address and browser type, for security and performance. Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, so your browser sends a request, including your IP address, to Google.

contact.title: Contact
contact.desc: How to reach World Issues Today for corrections, tips and advertising inquiries.
sections: Corrections to an issue (please include the page link), tips about what is trending in your country, and advertising or partnership inquiries. We usually reply within a few days.
If the site helps you, you can buy us a coffee on Ko-fi: {kofi}.
